# Original geometric font fixtures

These fonts are generated by `generate.py` from simple geometric paths under
the repository's license. They contain no copied system-font outlines or data.
They test coverage, complete-cluster fallback, advance changes, a synthetic
`fi` ligature and lifetime/invalidation; they are not typography examples.

- `MoxiTestPrimary.ttf`: ASCII, 500-unit advance, no combining marks.
- `MoxiTestFallback.ttf`: shared-corpus coverage, 700-unit advance.
- `MoxiTestWide.ttf`: the same coverage with 950-unit advance.

Regenerate with `python generate.py` in an environment containing `fonttools`.
The checked-in fonts need no Python font library to run. Font timestamps are
fixed for reproducible generation. Runtime text-laboratory states use resolved
system fonts and actual outlines instead of these test shapes.
